19:12 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The Indiana Pacers host the Philadelphia 76ers in NBA regular-season play at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. The Philadelphia 76ers have won four straight meetings against the Indiana Pacers, including a 105-94 victory at this venue last April.

21:35 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Dallas Mavericks host the Oklahoma City Thunder in NBA regular-season play at American Airlines Center. Oklahoma City, who have won three of the last four meetings, arrive as the NBA's top-ranked side by ELO heading into the new season.
